**Build passes now.** Exit code 0.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. Fixed in [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader leaves them `undefined`. Unset now means `false`, the old default. Fixed in [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are noise. `build.js` prints them as fixed strings. Nothing else to fix.
